title: Principal Analytics Business Partner
description:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate -we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role  

We are looking for a Principal Analytics Business Partner - Customer Success to join our team. This is a hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Business Intelligence in the Customer Success Organization department. At Zscaler, our Customer Success Organization is a global, customer-focused team dedicated to delivering exceptional customer outcomes through data, analytics, and operational excellence. We partner with business leaders to transform data into actionable intelligence that improves decision-making, drives customer value, and enables scalable business growth. In this role, you will serve as a strategic partner to Customer Success leadership, helping define business priorities, frame complex problems, and translate them into scalable analytics and intelligence solutions while collaborating closely with business leaders, Analytics Engineering, and Business Intelligence teams to support the evolving needs of Customer Success.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Lead strategic business partnerships: Build trusted relationships with Customer Success leaders to understand business priorities, identify opportunities, and proactively shape analytics initiatives that deliver measurable business value

• Drive analytical strategy and prioritization: Define problem statements, establish success criteria, and prioritize analytics initiatives based on business impact, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalable solutions

• Translate data into business decisions: Deliver clear, actionable insights that explain what is happening, why it matters, and what actions should be considered, enabling leaders to make informed decisions with confidence

• Lead cross-functional execution: Partner with Analytics Engineering, Business Intelligence, Operations, and business stakeholders to ensure analytical solutions are aligned, scalable, and successfully adopted across Customer Success

• Advance analytical maturity: Continuously improve KPI definitions, analytical methodologies, and reusable business frameworks while identifying opportunities to leverage automation and emerging AI capabilities to improve decision-making

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You are data-driven. You use data and analytics to find the truth, measure what matters, and guide informed decisions. You value evidence over assumptions, replacing "I think" with "I know" to drive better outcomes.

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindra

title: Manager, Financial Processes
description:
About the team

We're responsible for delivering a merchant experience that's both compliant and seamless - one that keeps merchants satisfied and engaged, while finding smarter, more efficient ways to serve them at lower cost.

About the role

The role of the S&O team is to define how we operate on a day-to-day basis with our merchant partners such that we are easy to do business with and deliver a market-leading partner experience at an acceptable cost. As the Financial Processes Manager, you will lead medium/large sized initiatives: identifying opportunities to improve partner experience or reduce costs, and drive execution across markets. You will iterate to optimise relevant end-to-end processes and work with functions across the Merchant Org. to ensure individual steps are being followed, and lead the “go-to-market” with internal and external stakeholders for all changes and improvements that you make to improve the processes.

What you'll be doing

- Own end-to-end payment process design - map, document, and continuously improve all Payment-related processes (including COO and COBD), defining clear success metrics to ensure they run efficiently and deliver a positive partner experience.

- Shape partner-facing policy - partner with Commercial, Legal, Policy, and Care teams to define and maintain transparent partner policies, leading non-regulatory policy design and providing the partner perspective on regulatory matters.

- Drive performance and continuous improvement - monitor key metrics across partner-facing processes, identify improvement opportunities through data analysis, and build roadmaps with clear business cases for change.

- Lead go-to-market for change initiatives - project manage the rollout of policy and process changes, working cross-functionally on communications and training, leading frontline change management, and reviewing post-launch performance to course-correct as needed.

Requirements

- Project & change management experience - a proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders across Commercial and other functions simultaneously, with a practical toolkit for guiding individuals and teams through change

- Strong process design skills - comfortable mapping end-to-end processes, spotting inefficiencies, and building compelling cases for change

- Sharp problem-solving and strategic thinking - able to cut through surface-level observations to identify root causes, prioritise effectively, and generate thoughtful, well-reasoned recommendations

- Solid business acumen - a clear understanding of the business model and customers, with the judgement to make sound trade-offs within projects

- Excellent communication and stakeholder influence - proactive, clear, and collaborative, with the ability to document and present ideas confidently to varied audiences

- A natural collaborator - a team player who works effectively across functions and can navigate or resolve misalignment between teams

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause

title: Customer Solutions Engineer
description:
Customer Solutions Engineer Job Description

Customer Solutions Engineers give Abnormal a flexible, technical resource for situations that fall between standard support and a long term, dedicated Technical Account Manager.  These engineers are floating technical specialists who partner with our CSM’s for the duration of a specific need and then step out, providing hands-on platform expertise, training, and optimization.  For instance, these resources can be engaged when a customer needs a short-term, project-based technical engagement (configuration optimization, best-practices review, post-deployment tune-up), or a CSM needs a consultative technical resource to work a tricky or recurring situation beyond what a standard support case can resolve.

The Customer Solutions Engineer is a complex and dynamic customer facing role with a focus on churn mitigation, product adoption, and optimization of customer configurations. It requires an individual with expert technical orientation, sound time management skills, a thorough understanding of the challenges and expectations of corporate IT teams, the ability to communicate clearly verbally and written, and an aura of expertise and authority regarding Abnormal products, services, and best practices.

What they will do:

• Serve as a flexible technical resource CSMs can bring into challenging or recurring account situations that a standard support case isn't built to resolve.

• Take on short-term, project-based technical engagements for customers without a dedicated TAM

• Partner with CSMs to assess customer technical needs, join investigative or best-practices calls, and determine the right next step.

• Lead hands-on platform optimization: configuration reviews, best-practices setup, and proactive tuning that prevents issues from recurring.

• Document session recaps and next steps in CRM so recommendations are clear to the customer and visible to the broader team.

• Advise customers on underused contracted features and flag upsell or professional services/deployment opportunities where relevant.

• Recognize when a situation exceeds this role's scope and hand it to the Critical Situation Manager or Technical Support with a clear, documented hand-off

• Surface patterns across engagements - recurring technical themes, segment-level gaps - to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to drive systemic improvement.

Essential Skills and Experience:

• 3+ years in a customer-facing technical role, including email infrastructure, IT security/administration, engineering, or technical support, in enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity.

• Solid grounding in Abnormal's platform and configuration best practices, sufficient to work independently with customers without a senior technical resource in the room.

• Comfortable stepping into a customer relationship for a defined engagement and stepping back out; this is not a standing account-ownership role.

• Strong triage judgment - able to recognize quickly whether a situation calls for hands-on technical guidance or a more senior technical resource.

• Able to manage multiple concurrent, time-bound engagements across a broad book of business rather than a fixed set of named accounts.

• Excellent communication skills across technical and business stakeholders, including comfort presenting to senior customer stakeholders.

• Strong planning and time-management skills to move fluidly between engagements without losing continuity for the customer.

• Empathy-driven, ownership mentality - comfortable jumping into ambiguous, unfamiliar technical situations without an existing playbook.

title: Senior Software Engineer - AI
description:
Who we are.
Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.
What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark .

• Design & scale async REST/WebSocket APIs with Python 3.11+ + FastAPI, using dependency-injection, type hints, and clean vertical-slice architecture.

• Implement multi-agent workflows with Semantic Kernel (handoff, sequential, concurrent) to route traffic among specialised LLM agents.

• Integrate LLM providers (OpenAI GPT-4.1/mini, Google Gemini 2.5 Flash) behind a provider-agnostic layer for A/B and cost-aware routing.

• Deliver Retrieval-Augmented Generation with vector stores such as Azure AI Search, pgvector, or Chroma.

• Expose tool-using agents via OpenAI Assistants (Code-Interpreter) for data-analysis / file-manipulation tasks.

• Evolve schemas with SQLModel / SQLAlchemy 2 & Alembic; tune Postgres for high concurrency async access.

• Maintain robust CI/CD (Bitbucket Jenkins) that lint, type-check, test, package (Docker), and deploy.

• Instrument services with structlog JSON logs, OpenTelemetry traces, and cost/latency metrics; hold p95

• Champion AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Cursor) and share pragmatic problem-solving practices with the team.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed. 

• 5 + yrs building production APIs in Python; 2 + yrs with FastAPI (or similar async stack).

• Deep knowledge of async I/O, Pydantic v2, DI, and observability.

• Hands-on with Semantic Kernel or comparable agent frameworks.

• Practical RAG implementations using Azure AI Search, pgvector, or Chroma.

• Strong Postgres skills, including SQLModel/SQLAlchemy 2 and Alembic migrations.

• Proven integrations or Side Projects with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini) and structured-output design.

• Dependency management via Poetry and virtual-env isolation.

• End-to-end CI/CD ownership (build → scan → test → deploy).

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving ability.

• Remote work readiness with daily overlap of at least 09:00 - 13:00 EST.

Nice to have.

• Event/message queues (RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus, Kafka).

• Observability stacks (Grafana, LangFuse) for LLM cost governance.

Join us to build the agent-powered backbone of our AI platform-robust, model agnostic, and ready for millions of users.

title: Scrum Master / Risk Analyst
description:
Job Summary
Scrum Master / Risk Analyst
Client: Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration, Office of Clinical Informatics
Location: Remote, with occasional travel as required
Clearance: Ability to obtain and maintain a VA Tier 1 / Public Trust background investigation
Employment Type: Full time, contingent on contract award
Position Summary
This position covers two jobs on one team. The Scrum Master side runs the team's sprints and Agile ceremonies, keeps work moving, and clears roadblocks. The Risk Analyst sidetracks risks to cost, schedule, and performance, keeps the risk register updated, and reports risk status to program leadership and the customer.
Most of the week is spent with the delivery team. The rest goes to collecting risk data from the program team, updating the register, and writing the risk sections of weekly and monthly reports.
Primary Responsibilities
W hat You Will Do: Scrum Master

• Run daily standups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

• Coach the team on Scrum and SAFe practices.

• Find and clear roadblocks. Raise the ones the team cannot fix on its own.

• Support Planning Interval planning, including prep work, dependencies, and what the team commits to.

• Work with other teams on shared or dependent work.

• Track team metrics such as velocity, burndown, and how well the team meets commitments, and use them to improve.

• Keep the team focused and the workload manageable during busy periods.

• Keep the backlog, board, and tools up to date.

What You Will Do: Risk Analyst

• Review risk data to find risks to cost, schedule, and performance, both in specific areas and across the program.

• Work with the program team to collect and check risk data.

• Keep the risk register current, including the risk, how likely it is, its impact, who owns it, and the plan to reduce it.

• Write and brief risk status for program leadership and the customer, in writing, in charts, and in person.

• Follow mitigation actions until they are closed and report on what risk is left.

• Help manage issues and escalations when a risk actually happens.

• Write the risk sections of weekly and monthly reports and other deliverables.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree.

title: Project Advisor
description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

- Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

- Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

- Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

ABOUT THE TEAM

We're expanding our Center of Excellence (COE) - a specialized Project Advisor team within Homeowner Success. COE Project Advisors are primarily outbound calling representatives who proactively connect with homeowners, and who also field return inbound calls from homeowners responding to prior outreach. In this role, you'll partner with homeowners to get Jobs Done Well - uncovering their project needs and matching them with the right pros - while representing the highest bar of service quality and consistency for the broader Project Advisor organization.

Since COE sets the standard for the team, members are also called on to participate in pilots, tests, and process improvements as business needs arise - helping shape how new tools, workflows, and initiatives roll out across the wider organization.

If you thrive in a dynamic, outbound-driven environment, bring excellent communication skills, and are committed to continuous improvement, we encourage you to apply.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

OUTBOUND & INBOUND CUSTOMER SUPPORT

- Proactively place outbound calls to homeowners to advance their project journey and identify additional needs.

- Field return inbound calls from homeowners responding to prior outreach, providing professional and courteous support.

- Identify, uncover, and discover additional project needs through natural conversation, and present matched pros clearly to homeowners based on those needs.

- Engage homeowners in tailored discussions about available services and solutions based on their project scope.

- Maintain current knowledge of products, policies, and procedures to give homeowners accurate, timely information.

PILOTS, TESTING & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

- Participate in pilots, tests, and special projects as business needs require, providing frontline feedback on new tools, scripts, and processes.

- Flex to support other lines of business (LOBs) on a temporary basis when COE capacity is needed elsewhere.

- Surface homeowner feedback and insights that inform broader service and process improvements.

TEAM COLLABORATION

- Collaborate with team members and leadership to share knowledge and best practices.

- Actively participate in Learning & Development activities that support both team growth and personal development.

- Support team goals and initiatives aimed at improving performance and customer satisfaction.

PERFORMANCE MONITORING

- Meet or exceed performance metrics, including Service Request (SR) conversion rate, matches per session, customer satisfaction (CSAT), and quality/accuracy scores.

- Seek and apply feedback from leadership to continuously improve performance and customer interactions.

- Maintain accurate, complete records of customer interactions and transactions in designated systems.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL NEED:

REQUIRED

- 1+ years of experience in a call center, outbound sales, or customer service environment.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to think quickly and resolve issues effectively.

- Ability to multitask and prioritize in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.

- Detail-oriented, with a consistent focus on high-quality customer service.

- Adaptable and willing to learn new skills, tools, and processes - including participating in pilots and tests

In collaboration with our cross-functional Celonis teams, you will drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate the adoption of our platform.  The CVP will also champion transformational initiatives across Celonis and customer accounts, fostering innovation and strategic change to maximize value and drive business transformation.

We seek experienced professionals with a proven track record in managing executive relationships, driving profitable growth, and blending industry expertise with strong analytical and consulting skills. Join us at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide and help guide our customers to become the next Lighthouse Celonis customers.

• Mentor and coach team members, providing guidance and support for their success, and offer feedback to managers on team performance.

Driving Customer Value

• Influence key customer stakeholders through executive communication, product knowledge, and industry/domain expertise.

Community Builder and Customer Advocacy

By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

As a Manufacturing Test Engineer on the Drones team you will be working directly with our Bolt, Anvil, and Ghost drones. You will be responsible for ensuring that we are testing our systems to stringent standards ensuring that we are consistently shipping the highest quality products to our customers. Additionally you will ensure that we are able to meet the required throughput requirements of production. In this role you’ll need to think creatively and come up with solutions to solve difficult testing problems and push to continuously improve our methods of automation, throughput, user interfaces, and data analytics.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Maintain ownership of test activities in production and ensuring production test flow. Provide hands-on troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex electrical issues found during testing.

• Maintain test capabilities across the manufacturing value stream - from system level checkouts and acceptance testing to key component level in process validation.

• Improve and sustain existing test systems to improve automation, consistency, total cycle time, and test coverage (DfM).

• Generate test work instructions that can be easily followed by technician team in MES. Train technicians on equipment use as required.

• Develop library of common failure modes with troubleshooting guide/diagrams for fast issue resolution.

• Determine root cause of product failures and recommend appropriate corrective actions (RCCA).

• Work with Design, Quality and Manufacturing Engineering teams to support customer returns and failure analysis.

• Contribute feedback to early-stage test design for test processes supporting early-stage products (NPI).

• Analyze test data, document results, and provide detailed reports to identify defects and areas for improvement.

• Collaborate with design engineers to provide feedback and recommendations for product enhancements based on test outcomes.

• Optimize test strategies for efficiency and effectiveness, reducing test time without compromising quality.

• Maintain and calibrate test equipment to ensure precision and reliability.

• Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

• Execute testing as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronics, Computer, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields

• 5+ years of relevant industry experience with emphasis on manufacturing test and product sustainment.

• Familiarity with Linux, Ubuntu, LabVIEW, and NixOS.

• Experience with contract manufacturers in the testing of PCBA/electronic assemblies. Thorough knowledge of PCBA testing standards and methods.

• Familiarity with electronics test equipment such as power supplies, electronic loads, oscilloscope, function generators, spectrum analyzers, data acquisition and measurement sensors.

• Strong root cause analysis skills of non-conforming hardware.

• Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal and communication skills.

• Familiar with Product Life Cycle (PLM) systems, Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), and Test Execution Systems (TES)

• Experience working on projects that involve the integration of electrical, mechanical, and software/firmware

title: Growth Creative Operations
description:
TL;DR: Lovable's growth marketing runs on creative. The volume, variety, and quality of concepts we put in front of people, and how fast what we learn from them turns into the next round. Your job is to own that loop end to end, constantly iterating on it to achieve the best results against your KPIs.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

What we’re looking for

- You've run high-volume creative testing on performance marketing and can talk specifically about what you learned, not just what you shipped.

- You use AI tools daily and have built something with them that other people now depend on. A workflow, an agent, an internal tool, a tagging pipeline.

- You have opinions about what makes an ad work and can articulate them well.

- You write well for ads. Briefs, hooks, scripts etc.

- You're comfortable being wrong in public. A lot of tests lose, and the loop only works if we’re all comfortable with that.

- You move fast, but balance that with exceptional craft and know where the balance is.

What you’ll do

You'll be the person who decides what we test, why, and what the results mean. Then you'll build the workflows that turn those answers into hundreds of assets a month without losing the taste that made them work in the first place.

- Own the creative operating system. You run creative ops for performance marketing: intake, briefing, production, QA, launch, and post-mortem. You'll define how the process works and then automate the parts that don't need a human in the loop.

- Be the creative performance decision maker. When we can produce hundreds of creatives, you’ll be the person to judge what we make more of, what gets killed and what to slightly edit. That means holding the creative standard high, and making sure that creatives generated look Lovable.

- Build agentic workflows and keep improving them. You'll design pipelines that generate, adapt, and localise creative at volume, with evals to check quality before anything ships. When a workflow breaks, you diagnose it and help rebuild it.

- Turn performance data, audience insights and product knowledge into concepts. You'll dig into what's actually driving results, hook, format, message, subject, pacing, offer, and separate the signal from the noise a low-spend winner creates.

- Run brainstorms and briefing. You own the rhythm that takes learnings, customer language, competitor moves, product releases, and additional context, and works with the wider team to turn them into briefs.

- Push learnings across the company. What wins on paid usually tells us something about the website, lifecycle emails, App Store listings, and organic content. You'll be the one making sure that reaches the relevant people so we become more informed collectively.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our comp

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
About Us

Lupa is building a category defining product the industry has never seen before.

We’re the AI-native operating system for veterinary practices and pet parents, replacing the fragmented, clunky systems vets have tolerated for years with a single intelligent platform for scheduling, client communication, clinical documentation, and AI-driven care guidance. Practices run more efficiently, vets get back to doing what they love, and pet parents feel more connected to their animals’ health than ever.

The traction speaks for itself: one of Europe’s top 100 AI startups with a team of 50 people, 10x growth in twelve months, the UK market leader, and now charging hard into the US and Europe. We have $25M in funding, 2.5M+ pets on the platform, and a buzzing New York office.

This is a rare chance to join a rocket ship at exactly the right moment and we’re looking for exceptional people to help us fly it.

In this role, you will:

- Own the full deployment of Lupa into veterinary practices, from the first kick-off call through to a live, confident team that doesn’t need hand-holding

- Immerse yourself in each practice’s workflows, understand how they actually operate day-to-day, and redesign those workflows around Lupa’s AI-native platform

- Synthesise what you’re hearing in the field, from vets, practice managers, and receptionists into a sharp picture of where the product needs to go next

- Partner with Engineering and Product to translate real-world clinical problems into platform improvements that scale across the entire customer base

- Lead training sessions that drive genuine adoption, not just surface-level sign-offs

- Present deployment outcomes and future roadmaps to stakeholders from practice owners to group-level executives

- Build and deliver demos that win new customers and expand existing ones

- Scope new deployment opportunities as we push into the US and new international markets

Your background looks something like:

- 3+ years in a deployment, implementation, forward deployment, or solutions engineering role ideally at a top tier management consultancy, B2B SaaS or tech company known for complex, high-touch deployments

- A track record of managing multiple concurrent deployments without losing quality, pace, or customer trust

- Comfortable engaging at every level of a customer organisation from the vet on the floor to the CFO in the boardroom

- Some experience with data, scripting, or analytical tools (SQL, Python, or similar) you don’t need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to work alongside one

- Experience in healthcare, veterinary, or another regulated, workflow-heavy industry (nice to have)

- Background at a company known for exceptional deployment quality Palantir, Salesforce, Veeva, or similar (nice to have)

As a person, you:

- Are not satisfied with surface-level answers you dig into the data, the workflow, and the real problem until you actually understand it

- Have low ego, the outcome matters more than who gets the credit, and you’re as comfortable following as you are leading

- Are genuinely curious and analytical, with a sharp instinct for product and a deep interest in how users think and behave

- Thrive in unstructured, ambiguous environments where no two days look the same and the playbook doesn’t exist yet

- Are excited to work in-person from our New York office.

- Value working with people who are kind, ambitious, and pragmatic

What does success look like in 6 months?

- You’re managing a portfolio of deployments independently and every practice you’ve taken live is a genuine Lupa advocate

- The product team trusts your field insight and is already acting on it, you’ve changed at least one roadmap decision

- You’ve helped shape how we deploy as we scale into the US, and your playbook is being used by the rest of the team

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Зараз ми в пошуку Motion Designer у New Venture.

У світі понад 1,8 мільярда людей вивчають іноземні мови, але менше ніж 10% здатні говорити ними вільно. Ми починаємо будувати середовище інтерактивної комунікації - AI Language Tutor - щоб говорити і робити помилки без страху осуду.

Наша мета - побудувати продукт, що навчатиметься разом з користувачем - збиратиме дані про нього, персоналізувати підхід і мотивувати до нових кроків. Ми не віримо в універсальні підходи до навчання, але знаємо, що алгоритми допоможуть користувачу навчатися in his own way of learning. І (нарешті) результативно.

 

Цей продукт ще потрібно побудувати. Тож якщо будувати щось з нуля - це про тебе, давай робити це разом?

Про роль: ти станеш людиною, яка перетворює ідеї на рух. На етапі від 0 до 1 наш головний канал зростання - це performance-відео, і саме твої креативи будуть тим, що зупиняє скрол і приводить перших користувачів. Ми шукаємо моушн-дизайнера, який мислить не лише красивою анімацією, а й метриками: розуміє, що креатив існує не заради естетики, а заради CTR і конверсії. Ти власноруч закладеш систему виробництва відеоконтенту, яка дозволить нам швидко тестувати десятки гіпотез і масштабувати те, що працює.

Що будеш робити:

- Виробництво performance-креативів: створення моушн-відео під рекламу (з фокусом на Meta) - анімація інтерфейсів, динамічні ролики, кінетична типографіка.

- Робота за сценаріями: реалізація детальних ТЗ та сценаріїв від Creative Marketing Manager - від хука до CTA.

- Швидка ітерація: тісна співпраця з UA та Creative-командою, аналіз ефективності креативів (CTR, CR) і швидке допилювання на основі даних.

- Побудова системи: створення бібліотеки шаблонів, пресетів та асетів, що дозволить виробляти багато варіацій без втрати швидкості та якості.

Що ми очікуємо від тебе:

- Досвід: 2+ років у моушн-дизайні для цифрових продуктів (рівень Middle), із сильним портфоліо саме performance-креативів.

- Технічна експертиза: впевнене володіння Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro); розуміння повного циклу виробництва відео - від раскадровки до фінального рендеру.

- AI-інструменти: практичний досвід роботи з AI-інструментами для генерації відео та графіки (Runway, Kling, Midjourney, Sora, Seedance тощо) для прискорення продакшену та виробництва варіацій.

- Performance-підхід: глибоке розуміння структури рекламного відео (хук, основна частина, CTA) і того, як анімація впливає на утримання уваги та конверсію.

- Швидкість: ти вмієш видавати обсяг і варіативність - десятки ітерацій під тестування гіпотез, а не один ідеальний ролик на місяць.

Буде великим плюсом:

- Розуміння специфіки EdTech або AI-продуктів.

title: Senior Cloud Security Engineer
description:
Ready to be a Titan?
We are seeking an experienced Staff Cloud Security Engineer to shape the security foundation of our modern cloud environments and next-generation applications. In this high-impact role, you will design cutting-edge automated security controls, harden multi-cloud infrastructure, and champion secure development practices across the organization. If you are passionate about cloud security, DevSecOps, and staying ahead of emerging threats, this role puts you right at the center of innovation.
What You’ll Do:
DevSecOps and Automation

• Pipeline Integration: Integrate robust security controls directly into CI/CD platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps.

• Automated Scanning: Evaluate and implement pipeline-based security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scanning. Manage and configure IaC scanning tools to surface true risk.

• Developer Feedback Loops: Build and optimize developer feedback loops and automated remediation workflows to ensure software is secure by default. Develop automated scripts using Python, Bash, or PowerShell to streamline security processes.

Identity and Access Management (IAM)

• Cloud Identity Controls: Build and maintain IAM security controls across cloud platforms, assessing policies to enforce the principle of least privilege.

• Non-Human Identity Management: Standardize management, security controls, and lifecycle expectations with regard to non-human identity.

• Secrets Management: Govern the secure use of cloud identities, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), and secrets management.

Infrastructure Security and Hardening

• Cloud Posture: Develop and implement secure infrastructure baselines, vulnerability management processes, and hardening standards across AWS, Azure, or GCP environments.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Validate security configurations and leverage IaC tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep to ensure repeatable, auditable, and secure infrastructure provisioning.

• Network Security: Tackle high-impact infrastructure projects such as multi-cloud network isolation, secure multi-tenant use, and continuous remediation of discovered misconfigurations.

Workload Security

• Cloud-Native Architectures: Guide engineering teams on secure architecture design for cloud apps, microservices, serverless services, and PaaS workloads.

• Container Security: Advance container and Kubernetes security by implementing runtime controls, supply-chain security, and configuration assessments.

• AI & Emerging Tech: Secure in-house and public AI/ML systems against cyber threats, adversarial attacks, and unauthorized access, ensuring models and data pipelines are protected throughout the solution lifecycle.

Data Security and Privacy

• Data Protection: Ensure that sensitive cloud and AI data is properly encrypted, anonymized, and securely stored.

• Encryption Standards: Assess and implement strong encryption configurations, checkpoint encryption, and tokenization to protect data at rest and in transit.

• Compliance Alignment: Develop and enforce policies to align data security and privacy measures with industry regulations, ethical standards, and organizational governance requirements.

Monitoring, Detection, and Response

• Threat Detection: Monitor and analyze security events using SIEM, Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and Cloud Workload Protection Platforms (CWPP).

• Incident Response: Support the triage, investigation, and forensic analysis of cloud-based application or pipeline security incidents, working collaboratively to contain and mitigate threats.

title: Executive Programs Lead, Americas
description:
About the Team

Enterprise Marketing helps the world’s largest organizations understand, adopt, and scale AI. Our Executive Engagement programs bring OpenAI’s products, research, and perspective into the room with senior leaders as they consider how intelligence can be put to work against their most important priorities.

These engagements are more than briefings or events. At their best, they help a leadership team understand what is changing, distinguish what is possible now from what is still emerging, and leave with greater clarity about what to do next.

About the Role

We are looking for an Executive Programs Lead, Americas to build and lead the portfolio through which OpenAI engages its most important customers and executives across the region.

You will own the regional strategy, team, and quality bar for Executive Briefings and a broader portfolio of C-suite engagements, recurring executive forums, advisory programs, and proven formats ready to scale. Your mandate is to turn high-stakes customer moments into a durable business capability, one that consistently advances important relationships while preserving the judgment and customization that exceptional executive experiences require.

This is a senior people-leadership role for a builder who can set direction, make disciplined portfolio choices, and create the systems and team required to deliver at scale. You will partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Research, Solutions, Customer Success, Events, and OpenAI executives, moving comfortably between long-term design and the critical details of a live engagement.

This role is based in San Francisco. We use a hybrid model of three days in the office each week and offer relocation assistance. Given the customer-facing nature of the role, regular in-person participation in executive briefings and related preparation is expected and may require additional time onsite. Travel across the Americas and occasional global travel are also expected.

In this role, you will:

- Own the Americas portfolio of recurring executive-engagement programs and the regional capability that supports them, setting its strategy, priorities, investments, and measures of success.

- Lead and develop the regional team responsible for program strategy, operations, and delivery, creating clear ownership and an unusually high standard of execution.

About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. Accordingly, our Global Affairs team builds authentic, collaborative relationships with public officials and the broader AI policymaking community to inform and support our shared work in these domains. We ensure that insights from policymakers inform our work and - in collaboration with our colleagues and external stakeholders - seek to shape policy so that it aligns with and supports our mission.

About the Role

As AI agents move from answering questions to taking action across the internet, the standards that govern identity, delegated authority, discovery, communications, agentic-commerce and payment interfaces, agent-facing web access, agent-specific provenance, and auditability will determine whether agents can operate safely, interoperably, and with clear accountability. OpenAI is looking for an Agent Standards Manager to lead execution of our external technical standards strategy for a defined set of agent standards workstreams.

This role will work closely with Agent Security, Applied and Platform teams, Product, Legal, GRC, Global Affairs, and GTM to turn OpenAI’s technical architecture and controls into credible specifications, protocol profiles, assurance criteria, and implementation guidance-and to bring emerging external requirements back into product and security roadmaps before they become blockers. The positions developed here are technical standards positions, not broad public-policy positions.

This is a builder’s role as much as an external-facing role. You will also help create repeatable processes that let the company shape agent standards without depending on a single person or relying on technical teams to carry external standards work on top of their core jobs.

The Agent Standards Manager is an integrator, not the owner of every underlying technical system. Security, Product, Engineering, and other designated technical teams retain ownership of architecture, threat models, controls, product decisions, approvals, and implementation. This role owns workstream planning, standards translation, drafting, negotiation, external representation within approved mandates, commitment traceability, and implementation handoff.

- Embed with Agent Security and Applied or Platform teams to translate internal architecture and controls into technically credible specifications, profiles, white papers, and assurance evidence without overstating maturity or deployment status.

- Lead review and approval paths across Product, Security, Engineering, Legal, GRC, Global Affairs, and GTM; maintain clear mandates, red lines, owners, dependencies, and external commitments.

You will integrate hardware and software onto vehicle platforms and deploy autonomy algorithms in both SIL, HIL and live test environments.  Computer networking, code integration, and a passion for robotics integration is a must.   You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable solutions for defense and commercial customers, providing seamless hardware-software integration, troubleshooting, and customer-facing demonstrations.

If you're a strong C++ engineer with no prior drone experience but a keen interest in the space, this role could be an ideal fit.

- Adapt and develop modular and agile autonomy capabilities across diverse defense problems

- Integrate and deploy autonomy solutions onto embedded Linux and other hardware platforms, including interfacing with sensors and collecting data

- Integrate autonomy software into hardware in collaboration with autonomy engineers that supports full integration with aircraft autopilots, datalinks, sensors, PNT/GPS/INS, ground control stations, etc.

- Collaborate with 3rd party UAS vehicle vendors on the integration of Applied autonomy software onto OEM UAS hardware

- Conduct system-level setup, testing, and validation, including software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop evaluations

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

- BS or MS in Robotics, Computer Science or related engineering field

- 3+ years of hands-on experience working with robotic systems (hardware, software, and integration)

- Experience with software programming languages: C++ preferred

- Experience integrating autonomy/robotics products with Pixhawk autopilots (ArduPilot and/or PX4)

- Experience integrating with communication busses & protocols: UART/RS232/RS422/RS485 , SPI/QSPI , I2C , Ethernet

- Experience developing in Docker, containerized deployment environments, and using Linux-based operating systems (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu)

- Experience using git

title: Account Manager - Benelux Market
description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

As AI reshapes how consumers search, discover, and choose brands, Trustpilot’s unique dataset of authentic human sentiment is becoming increasingly critical. We are uniquely positioned to define how trust and reputation function in an AI-driven digital economy and we’re building an inclusive environment where curious, ambitious people can do the best work of their careers.

As an Account Manager, you are responsible for retaining and growing a defined portfolio of existing customers on the Benelux market focusing on our Mid Market customer segment. You act as the commercial owner of each relationship - identifying the value drivers for the customer, setting up joint business goals and KPIs, driving renewals, expanding accounts, and positioning Trustpilot as a long-term partner that delivers measurable business value.

You combine commercial acumen with relationship depth, collaborating closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure adoption, satisfaction, and sustainable revenue growth. You are accountable for contributing to strong Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) and Net Revenue Retention (NRR) results by executing defined renewal processes, maintaining Salesforce accuracy, and supporting customers to achieve measurable value.

This role requires native-level Dutch and strong professional English language skills. It is based in our Amsterdam office.

What you'll be doing:

• Own your Book of Business and expand your revenue. Take ownership of your numbers.

• Identify Customers Goals and Drivers in order to derive its individual Trustpilot value drivers. Set up joint business goals and KPIs to measure success.

• Strategically understand the customers situation, know their goals and challenges.

• Own the end-to-end renewal process, delivering high Gross Renewal Rates (GRR) and predictable retention.

• Drive portfolio expansion through upsell and cross-sell to achieve strong Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and overall portfolio growth.

• Build and maintain detailed account plans, stakeholder maps, and accurate forecasts in Salesforce.

• Lead commercial and strategic conversations, including business reviews and contract discussions.

• Partner with Customer Success to ensure value realization, with Marketing on customer stories, and with Product on feedback loops.

• Ensure accurate data, forecasting discipline, and pipeline visibility across your portfolio.

Who you are:

• Fluent in Dutch and English.

• You have experience in account management, expansions, renewals or a similar customer-facing role within a SaaS or subscription-based company.

• You focus on customers goals and how to generate value for the customer. You are a value based thinker and seller.

• Strong understanding of financial numbers, P&Ls, retention, NRR, upsell, and cross-sell motions.

• Solid commercial awareness with the ability to link product value to customer outcomes.

• Skilled at managing a large portfolio and keeping accurate account data in CRM systems.

• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills.

• Comfortable analysing account performance data and forecasting renewals.

• Able to work cross-functionally and thrive in a fast-moving, target-driven environment.

• A good understanding of the digital advertising/search marketing industry - preferred.

What’s in it for you:

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 20 holiday days plus 5 extra holiday

• 2 (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Full access

title: Senior Domain Engineering Specialist
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role
The ideal candidate will be naturally collaborative, articulate, extremely organized, have a solid technical understanding of Veeam products, and motivated by maximizing customer success and outcomes. Soft skills combined with technical skills are key in this role. You will partner with Customer Success Engineers (CSEs) and Account Executives (AEs) to drive customer outcomes across security-related products and use cases within the Veeam Data Platform (VDP). You’ll lead readiness checks, data modeling, and risk conversations with CISO/CIO stakeholders, while monitoring telemetry and maturity against the Veeam Data Resilience Maturity Model (DRMM) to optimize posture and identify expansion opportunities.
What You’ll Do

• Engage customers on security-related products, architectures, and risk topics across the Veeam Data Platform (VDP).

• Run readiness checks and lead data modeling to validate solution design and accelerate decisions.

• Monitor attack surfaces and vulnerabilities (including DRMM scoring), track telemetry or recurring inspection signals, report trends, and capture potential health checks.

• Validate designs to de-risk adoption and accelerate time to value.

• Identify and articulate expansion opportunities; review consumption trends and schedule checkpoint reviews (with or without AE coordination).

• Engage CISO/CIO stakeholders for risk, status, and opportunity discussions; synthesize inputs from account health and CSE-led QBRs.

• Support AEs on security- and AI-driven expansion motions; influence roadmap priorities with CSE counterparts.

• Operate as a pooled resource covering Enterprise and Commercial-Named accounts (generally $100K+ ARR), typically at a 1 Security Success Engineer to 6-8 CSE coverage ratio.

• Note: Not the primary owner for Onboarding motions nor directly responsible for Renewals

What You’ll Bring

• 5+ years of experience in engineering architecture for cybersecurity-related products (e.g., Security Engineer/Architect, Cloud Solution Architect, MLOps/ML Engineer).

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus.

• Relevant certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent).

• Expertise in data security and governance, including DSPM/DLP; familiarity with AI/ML architectures.

• Demonstrated ability to engage CISO/CIO stakeholders on risk, resilience, and modernization roadmaps.

• Hands-on experience with solution design, POCs, telemetry monitoring, and maturity modeling (DRMM familiarity is a plus).

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• VMCE certification (can be completed after joining)

What You’ll Get

• Statutory benefits: healthcare coverage, occupational accident insurance, and unemployment cover included.

• State pension: contributions to the public pension system are covered in line with local rules (18.6% of salary, capped at €5,800/month).

• Accident insurance: 24/7 worldwide coverage, including disability and death benefits and rescue cost coverage.

• Supplementary pension plan: we contribute €302 net per month to a group pension plan; you can top it up, and your contributions are tax-exempt (you can also transfer an existing plan into ours).

• Time off: 30 days of annual

Elle devra naturellement se tenir à jour et approfondir ses connaissances sur les produits d’Atlassian, les technologies connexes et d’autres outils de collaboration, comme Slack.
Conseiller les clients en solutions Atlassian.

• Communiquer régulièrement avec différents intervenants.

• Participer au partage et à l’amélioration des connaissances à l’interne.

• Installer, mettre à niveau et effectuer la migration des applications Atlassian et des technologies connexes.

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions d’Atlassian adaptées aux besoins du client, p. ex., flux de travail, extensions/scripts, configuration.

• Administrer la base de données et les demandes.

• Assurer l’intégration Web d’Atlassian et d’autres applications à l’aide de l’interface Rest API.

title: Senior Product Data Analyst
description:
Reface шукає Product analyst в команду продукту Bitepal . Якщо тобі цікаві продуктові челенджі, дослідження поведінки та досвіду користувачів, формування продуктової та монетизаційної стратегії, робота з сучасними інструментами та сильною командою - ми з нетерпінням чекаємо на твоє резюме.
BitePal app - гейміфікований AI-трекер для їжі, який перетворює нудний підрахунок калорій на гру з віртуальним петом, дозволяючи формувати здорові звички без зайвого стресу; зайняв 2ге місце по завантаженням в світі (Jan’26) і 8,7x YoY Growth in downloads, #1 Health & Fitness Apps in 15 countries.

Про нас:

Reface - українська мультипродуктова компанія, що створює мобільні АІ-застосунки. За 5 років наші продукти завантажили понад 250М разів. Ми були № 1 в USA App Store, отримали Google Play’s Best App та залучили інвестиції від Andreessen Horowitz.

Про тебе:

• ти маєш 4+ роки досвіду в аналітиці мобільних застосунків (entertainment, utilities, health&fitness)

• ти розумієш subscription модель монетизації, маєш досвід прогнозування LTV користувачів

• ти залучений в продукт, з яким працюєш, розумієш метрики, сегменти, шлях та портрет користувача, генеруєш гіпотези та вмієш проводити A/B тести для їх валідації

• ти організований та формуєш фреймворк, в якому бачиш картину продукту і не лише маєш відповіді, а і ставиш питання; і розумієш як для цього налаштувати аналітику

• в тебе є базове розуміння performance маркетингу та шляхів залучення користувачів

• ти сильний в SQL, користуєшся Amplitude та вмієш доносити сенс через Tableau

Що ти будеш робити:

• досліджувати користувачів, пропонувати ідеї покращення функціонала застосунку та монетизації

• планувати, проводити A/B тести та оцінювати їх результат

• працювати над удосконаленням LTV моделі

• налаштовувати аналітику для нових функцій та оцінювати їх вплив на продукт і користувацький досвід

• удосконалювати аналітичні інструменти та процеси

• будувати інформативні дашборди для всієї команди продукта

Процес найму гнучкий : intro call →tech interview → можливе коротке тестове → знайомство з product owner → оффер.

Що ми пропонуємо:

•
Unlimited Vacation Policy: Ми серйозно. Ми не обмежуємо дні відпустки, бо довіряємо твоєму feel of ownership. Твій work-life balance - це твоя відповідальність, а ми даємо повний карт-бланш на відновлення, щоб ти завжди був у ресурсі.

•
Level Up Your Game: Твій розвиток драйвить наш бізнес. Виділяємо річний бюджет на профільні курси, воркшопи чи конференції. Хочеш опанувати новий AI-тул чи прокачати софт скіли? We got you covered.

•
Health & Care: Повне медичне страхування після випробувального терміну та оплачувані лікарняні без зайвих довідок. Plus, корпоративні знижки від партнерів, щоб закривати побутові потреби вигідніше.

•
Unbreakable Hub: Наш офіс у Києві - це твоя фортеця стабільності. Безперебійне світло, вода та зв’язок гарантовані, тож ти можеш фокусуватися на задачах, а не на графіках відключень.

•
Culture of Feedback: Жодної бюрократії та ієрархії заради ієрархії. Ми будуємо культуру відкритого діалогу, де фідбек - це інструмент росту, а команда завжди готова підтримати твої найсміливіші ідеї.

•
Impact That Matters: Ми не просто працюємо, ми наближаємо перемогу. Через наш Reface Fund ми системно допомагаємо країні, і ти станеш частиною цієї важливої місії.

title: Data Analyst II
description:
About Us:
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.
Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers-ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies-depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.
We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture-recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years-emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.
What It’s Like to Work at YipitData :
YipitData isn’t a place for coasting-it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.
From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.
What It's Like to Work Here

•
Ownership is real, not aspirational. An analyst here can own a data product end-to-end - from methodology to client delivery - and present directly to the investors who depend on it. You won't spend months waiting for "meaningful work."

• Growth is driven by impact , not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. We promote based on what you've done, not how long you've been here.
